title: TransitionResult
description: Result of `rebar transition … --output json` and `rebar reopen` (and the library transition()/reopen() / MCP transition_ticket/reopen_ticket): {ticket_id, from, to, newly_unblocked[]}. newly_unblocked lists tickets unblocked by a close (empty otherwise). Exit 10 (ConcurrencyError) on a stale current_status still applies and emits no JSON. completion_signature is present ONLY on a close where a completion signature was in play — absent for a plain transition, for reopen, and for `idea -> closed` (a REJECT/DROP, not a completion). Because the close COMMITS before signing is attempted, signed=false means the ticket IS closed and only the attestation is missing; it never means the close failed.

completion_signature.description: What became of the completion signature on a close. Optional: see the top-level description for when it is absent.

cause.description: signed: persisted. sign_failed: the append failed (transient lock timeout or a permanent signing degrade) — see error. material_drifted: the code moved between verify and sign, so stale state was deliberately not attested. force_bypassed: --force skipped signing by user approval.
